finding.text: Requirement 5 says "the refining model writes [the cards] onto the page with the page tools", but `Compose.cards`/`Compose.brief` (ext/Refine/stages/Compose.js:3-29) build the cards and the refined prompt in code, and Servex writes them (Servex/ext/refine/VoicePage.js:151-156). STATE.md never says this departs from the brief or names the alternative. Either have the model write the cards, or record the decision and the reason in STATE.md and voice-to-page.md.

The phone proof does not test the phone path. phone-proof.mjs:318 loads the page on 127.0.0.1, so `servex_url` resolves to `127.0.0.1:8090`, and the script then reroutes that by hand. On the phone (`10.0.0.135:8137`), `/api/voice` goes through `<origin>/servex/…` (`Server/plugins/ServexProxy.js`), and nothing exercised that route. Load the page by the LAN IP in the headless run, or at least open the `/servex/api/voice` proxy route at 400 px.

`Connection.restart_note` (ux/Dictate/Connection.js:1091) shows "Whisper stopped and Servex is restarting it" whenever the status is not `online`. `/api/whisper` returns `"unknown"` when no whisper process is registered (Servex/Servex.js `/api/whisper`; for example with `NO_WHISPER`, or a Whisper that is not supervised), and the line would then say something false. Only say "restarting" when the status is starting or crashed.

Nothing in task.jsonl shows the `owner_note` (kind `needs-you`) that requirement "For tomorrow's test" asks for, and the task has no `finish-task` landing. The owner's test tomorrow depends on that note.
Requirement "Reproduce first" asked for dictation (a recorded audio file is fine). STATE.md's baseline only times `/api/refine` on text, so the Whisper → raw stage was never timed, before or after.
"Whisper stays up" asks that it survive a reload and a phone reconnect. whisper-proof.mjs only proves restart after a crash, and STATE.md says the in-browser line is unproven.

Each partial writes the whole transcript into page.jsonl about every 150 ms (`raw`, `text` and `clean` together; VoicePage.js:143). A 2-minute dictation adds hundreds of lines, and the file grows roughly with the square of the text length. That is replayed on every load of the session page. Writing only every ~1 s, or only the new words, would keep it small.

If you refine a second time within 60 s without `next()`, the server's VoicePage is still `raw_closed` (VoicePage.js:140). The Raw stage then keeps the old words while Clean, Structure and Cards show the new ones. Also, the `catch` at run.js:217 skips `failed()` when the prompt id was generated rather than passed in.
The brief says the flow should work "whether the owner dictates in the browser or the app". Only the Refine page streams to `/api/voice`; the app/VS Code path is not mentioned.

Requirement "Layout-check at 400/1200/1920/3440": no shots or layout.json reached this review; STATE.md says only "no overflow". Requirement "Close the transcription `now` loose ends" is met: loose-ends.md checks all 10 rows with evidence.

The brief says the flow "works the same whether the owner dictates in the browser or the app", but only the Refine page posts to `/api/voice`; STATE.md item 9 says the app path is not wired. Either wire it, or show the app's prompts already reach `run_refine` with `session` + `prompt` set (Servex/ext/refine/run.js:228 writes the page only when `id` is set).

"Reproduce first" asks for a recorded audio file fed headless, with each stage's timing in STATE.md. No audio was run, so the Whisper → raw step is never timed (STATE.md item 5). That step is the one most likely to lag on the phone.

The layout check at 400/1200/1920/3440 is a done-when item, but `layout-check.mjs` was not run and the task folder has no `shots/` (STATE.md item 10, `review/` holds only diff.patch). "No horizontal overflow" is not a layout review.

VoicePage.js:109/202: a prompt is only dropped from `VoicePage.open` by `done()`, which only `run_refine` calls. If someone dictates and never presses Refine, the prompt and its `lines` stay in memory until Servex restarts, and `GET /api/voice/stream` replays them to every follower. A timeout after the last partial would fix it.

Cards are made by code (`Compose.cards`), not written by the refining model as stage 5 of the brief says. The reason and the alternative are recorded in stages/doc/voice-to-page.md, which is reasonable, but it differs from the owner's words, so the try-it doc should say so in one line.

Servex.js:53: `POST /api/voice` takes no auth and has CORS open, and it is reachable from the LAN through `<origin>/servex`. Anyone on the network can write voice items onto any session's page.jsonl. The risk is low (data only, 20k cap), but it is a new LAN write path.

The phone stream was only proven with Playwright pointing EventSource straight at the private Servex (phone-proof.mjs:381). SSE through the dev proxy at `/servex` (buffering, timeouts) was never exercised, and that is the exact path the phone uses tomorrow.

RefineSystem.js `quick()` returns early once a prompt is `done`, so text edited after a Refine does not stream to the page until Refine is pressed again (RefineDemo.js:97 then starts a new prompt id). This is fine, but try-it.md promises raw words "while you speak or type".
stages/files.jsonl lists `Stage.js`/`Stage.css` and later marks them `gone`. That is harmless in an append log, but the first two lines point at files that never landed.
